name: firstMinimum_mul_le_hom
summary: A short basis Y of S turns a nonzero vector z of Hom(S, T) into vectors z·Y_k of T, one of them nonzero; its length is at least λ_T and at most |z|·|Y|.

steps.claim: Characterise the capped first minimum (le_firstMinimum_iff): a number is at most λ_{Hom(S,T)} when it is at most 1 and at most the length of every nonzero lattice vector.
The bound is at most 1, by the cut-off: λ_S, λ_T ≤ 1 (firstMinimum_le_one) and the constants are ≥ 1; take a nonzero vector z of the Hom lattice.
steps.lean:
use by grw [firstMinimum_le_one, firstMinimum_le_one] <;> simp [Nat.cast_inv_le_one,
    ← Nat.cast_mul], fun z _ o ↦ ?_

steps.claim: A short basis Y of S (exists_short_basis: columns in the lattice, entries bounded by c/λ_S, a dual matrix).
steps.lean: choose Y hY hY' using S.exists_short_basis hd

steps.claim: For each column k, z·Y_k lies in the lattice of T with norm at most |z|·|Y_k| (mem_and_norm_le_of_vecAtPoint).
steps.lean:
choose a b using (T.mem_and_norm_le_of_vecAtPoint _ S · (vecToMat (vecAtPoint _ z)) 1 (fun w ↦
    l2_opNorm_le_of_apply ((archCoords _ z).norm_apply_le ⟨w, ·, ·⟩)) (by erw [one_smul,
    vecAtPoint_hom _ _ (vecToMat z), ratMap_mulVec_vecAtPoint]))

steps.claim: Some z·Y_k is nonzero (else z·Y = 0 and z = 0, Y being invertible), so λ_T ≤ |z·Y_k| ≤ |z|·c|n'||n|/λ_S.
steps.lean:
grw [firstMinimum_le (a _ (by simp_all [baseLattice]) (hY _)) (Function.ne_iff.1 fun H :
    (vecToMat z * Y.1)ᵀ = 0 ↦
    o (by simpa using! congr(matToVec ($Hᵀ * Y.2)))).choose_spec, b, hY']; simp [field]
